First beta of AnythingLLM Custom, a desktop build of [AnythingLLM](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm) 1.20.0 made from source. It installs alongside the official desktop app and keeps its own data (`anythingllm-custom`).

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `AnythingLLM-Custom-Setup-1.20.0-beta1.exe` |
| Linux x64 (Debian/Ubuntu) | `anythingllm-custom_1.20.0-beta1_amd64.deb` |

Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Installers are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen warns on first run.

Linux: `sudo apt install ./anythingllm-custom_1.20.0-beta1_amd64.deb`, then open **AnythingLLM** from the menu.

## What's new compared with upstream

- **Built-in local models (Lemonade / llama.cpp)** in the desktop app on Windows and Linux. The engine downloads on first use.
- **Model management in LLM Preference**: browse and download GGUF models from Hugging Face, or import a local `.gguf` file.
- **AnythingLLM (GGUF) embedder**: run GGUF embedding models such as Qwen3-Embedding on the same engine, with the same model manager.
- **Responsive layout** that follows the window width, so resizing the desktop window switches between desktop and mobile layouts live.
- **Desktop integration**: native file picker for GGUF import, open the models, data and logs folders, tray with background mode, global shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+Space), and notifications when downloads or embeddings finish.
- Server and collector listen on 127.0.0.1 only, and all data lives in the user data folder.

## Known issues

- On Windows, GPU acceleration (Vulkan/CUDA), the tray, and the file picker are only covered by CI smoke tests so far; please report problems.
- Below 768 px window width, the Agents and beta features settings pages show extra scrollbars.
- The installed size is about 1.6 GB.
